title: Capehart and Continetti on the White House press secretary's quick exit
summary: Columnists Jonathan Capehart and Matthew Continetti discuss the White House press secretary's exit after just five days, and what it says about vetting and turnover in a second-term administration. They then debate the widening rift between President Trump and President Zelenskyy, including the Russian diesel deal. Finally they weigh the privately funded White House ballroom and whether its donors should be disclosed.
focus: Shadow Continetti's answer on 'second-term-itis' and Capehart's answer on the ballroom: two different styles of opinionated, well-structured argument that work well in meetings.
